svg.title: Crimson Veil — repository architecture and scan lifecycle
svg.desc: Current source-code architecture, including the Rust kiosk, Python service and scan pipeline, real and simulated acquisition, pyEIT and stub reconstruction, baseline lifecycle, deployment, tests, and incomplete physical hardware.
svg.text: Repository architecture / how measurements become an image
Kiosk shows the scan with a HUD.
02 PYTHON HOST · LAPTOP OR RASPBERRY PI
with the same adjacent scan order.
No USB connection or ESP32 is used.
Heuristic demo data, not a FEM model.
WebSocket commands, status and scan responses
Continuous schedule: 60 s active / 120 s idle
Blocking pipeline work runs in a worker thread
JSON scan_result header immediately precedes PNG
Open hardware and set up the solver once
One acquisition at a time; reject concurrent work
Capture reference → validate → retain in RAM
Pass that same baseline to later target scans
WebSocket :8765 · JSON commands / ready / state / errors
Capture baseline uses acquire → validate → session storage.
acquire → reconstruct → encode · returns PNG bytes
Returns phantom ground truth; ignores readings.
core/types.py · DeviceConfig, MeshConfig, RawPoint, ScanData, ConductivityMap
Cached ESP32 telemetry or Linux sysfs fallback
Missing values → null; feeds the kiosk status bar
Reconnect; mirror messages; pair header + PNG
Scan disc, status readouts and reveal animation
Then introduce the change to be imaged.
pyEIT waits for a baseline before auto-scanning.
Frequency change or session close clears it.
Kept in RAM; no scan database is implemented.
04 BUILD, OPERATE, TEST AND UNDERSTAND THE REPOSITORY
Xorg / Openbox → supplied Rust kiosk binary
Backend and pyEIT selection are configured separately.
calibrate is a placeholder, not gain/phase calibration.
prints measurements and size, outside service runtime.
FEM ordering, polarity and anomaly quadrants
Baseline lifecycle, serial recovery, firmware doubles
118 Python tests pass on release + upstream pyEIT.
Rust build remains unverified on this host.
conceptui.png · design reference, not a runtime screen
WHAT IS VALIDATED — AND WHAT STILL NEEDS BRING-UP
Software path: synthetic acquisition → solver → PNG → WebSocket is tested.
Default sim + stub is a demo. pyEIT images relative conductivity change.
Physical path: AD5933.measure() unfinished; mux addressing and calibration unresolved.
Firmware telemetry helper is not scheduled; the host can fall back to sysfs or null.
Read the numbered strip first. Solid arrows: runtime flow. Dashed blue: simulation. Dashed grey: shared dependencies.
